newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Comerci, Tamsa, Gidusa rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Comerci, Tamsa, Gidusa rated buy.

text.p: -- Brokerage house BBV-Probursa reiterated its buy recommendations on Controladora Comercial Mexicana (Comerci), Tubos de Acero de Mxico (Tamsa) and Grupo Industrial Durango (Gidusa).
-- In a report on retail company Comerci, BBV-Probursa said its recommendation was backed by a debt restructuring plan and a positive economic outlook.
-- "Debt restructuring, as well as the plan to make a public offering toward the end of 1996, have the aim of improving the (company's) financial structure," it said.
-- Probursa estimated full year 1996 and 1997 operating margins at 3.6 percent and 3.8 percent, respectively.

-- The brokerage based its recommendation on steel tube manufacturer Tamsa on the company's hefty investment plans, the growing demand for its high value added products, and its ever healthier financial structure.
-- "Tamsa will invest almost 50 million dollars in 1996 and 1997 for increasing installed capacity, efficiancy and productivity drives, and on pollution control," the brokerage said.
-- It stressed that Tamsa has changed its sales mix and is now focusing on higher value added products.

-- On the paper company Gidusa, BBV-Probursa cited its restructuring of its debt by issuing Yankee bonds at low interest rates, its purchase of Aatensa, and the price at which its shares currently trade.
-- The brokerage estimated that Gidusa stock would yield an estimated 70 percent return over the coming months.
